title: The Locked Room
briefing_md:
Vikram Rathore, 58, owner of Rathore Publishing House, was found dead at 11:20 PM on the floor of his study, beside the library ladder.

The study door was locked, and his key lay on the desk inside. The window was open a few inches. It looked as if a burglar got in and Vikram fell from the ladder.

The police are not convinced.

Three people are being talked about:
• Daniel Rathore, 28, his nephew and heir, who owes money to friends. He says he was at the cinema all evening.
• Sarah Menon, 45, his business partner and chief editor for 15 years. She says she only dropped some papers at the gate around 10:15 PM and never entered the house.
• Meera Iyer, 52, the housekeeper for 20 years. She served coffee in the study at 10:10 PM.

Most people suspect Daniel, who inherits everything. What really happened, and who did it?

clue.label: The window
clue.title: Study window and the garden below
clue.text:
• The window is open 6 inches. The sill and the curtain are dry.
• No fingerprints on the latch or the frame.
• The flower bed below has soft soil, completely undisturbed.
• It rained from 9:00 PM to 10:00 PM.

questions.question: Which explanation fits every one of these facts?
options: A burglar climbed in after the rain, stepping through the flower bed
The window was opened after the rain, and nobody climbed through it
A burglar climbed in before the rain, and the rain washed his marks away
The window stood open all evening, but nobody happened to use it

clue.label: The ladder
clue.title: Library ladder and the doctor's note
clue.text:
• No scuff marks on any rung.
• The dust on the top shelf is untouched.
• Vikram was found lying beside the ladder.
• Doctor: “One injury only: a blow to the back of the head from something small and heavy. No bruises on the arms, hips or legs.”

questions.question: What do the ladder and the doctor's note show together?
options: He fell from the top while reaching for a book on the highest shelf
He slipped on the lowest rung, which is why the upper rungs are clean
He was struck, and the ladder was placed to make it look like a fall
A burglar used the ladder to reach the window and knocked him over

clue.label: Wall clock
clue.title: The clock, the housekeeper and the phone
clue.text:
• The wall clock's glass is cracked. Its hands stopped at 10:47.
• Meera: “At about 10:45 I heard shouting from the study.”
• Vikram's phone: he sent a message at 10:36 PM.
• The body was found at 11:20 PM.

questions.question: What is the narrowest time window for the attack that all of this supports?
options: Between 9:00 PM and 10:00 PM, while it was raining
Between 10:10 PM and 10:36 PM, just after the coffee
Between 10:50 PM and 11:20 PM, just before he was found
Between 10:36 PM and about 10:47 PM

clue.label: Paperweight
clue.title: Brass owl paperweight
clue.text:
• Found under the sofa, wiped clean.
• A clean circle in the dust on the desk shows where it normally sits.
• Everything else in the room (desk, cups, shelves) still has fingerprints on it.

questions.question: Only one object in the room was wiped. What does that tell us?
options: Someone took it from the desk, used it, and then tried to hide that
The housekeeper cleaned the whole study earlier that evening
A burglar brought his own weapon and left it behind in a hurry
Vikram knocked it off the desk himself as he fell backwards from the ladder

clue.label: Coffee cups
clue.title: Two cups on the table
clue.text:
• One cup of black coffee.
• One cup with sugar, and a torn sugar sachet beside it. Both cups are half empty.
• Meera: “Sir asked for two coffees at 10:00. I served them at 10:10; he was alone then. Sir drinks his black. Sarah madam always takes sugar, and so do many of his guests.”

questions.question: What can we safely conclude from the cups?
options: Meera sat down and drank the second cup with him at 10:10
The second cup proves beyond doubt that the visitor was Sarah
Vikram was expecting a visitor, and that visitor sat and drank with him
Vikram poured both cups for himself and drank from each

clue.label: Phone
clue.title: Vikram's phone
clue.text:
Last message sent, 10:36 PM, to his lawyer:
“Meet me 9 AM. I am ending Sarah's partnership. Bring the papers.”

questions.question: Which statement from the case file does this message make most important to check?
options: Daniel's statement that he was at the cinema all evening
Meera's statement that she served coffee at 10:10 PM
The lawyer's statement that he was free at 9 AM
Sarah's statement that she never entered the house

clue.label: Cinema
clue.title: Daniel's evening
clue.text:
• Ticket stub: 9:30 PM show, ended 11:00 PM.
• Cinema car park stamps for his car: IN 9:20 PM, OUT 11:01 PM.
• The cinema is 15 minutes from the house.
• Daniel: “I didn't even know there was a spare key. Uncle never trusted me with anything.”

questions.question: Could Daniel have attacked Vikram at about 10:47 PM?
options: Yes: a ticket stub proves nothing at all, so he has no alibi for the evening
No: his car stayed at the cinema until 11:01, 15 minutes away
Yes: the film ended at 11:00, well before the body was found
No: because he did not know where the spare key was kept

clue.label: The door
clue.title: The locked study door
clue.text:
• The study door was locked. The lock turns only with a key, from either side.
• Vikram's own key was on the desk inside.
• Nobody came or went through the window.

questions.question: If this was murder, what must be true?
options: There is a second key, and the killer knew where to find it
The killer climbed out through the window after all
The killer was still hiding somewhere in the study when it was opened at 11:20 PM
Vikram locked the door himself after he was struck

twist_md: New evidence has come in: the gate guard's log, Vikram's diary and a second key to the study.

clue.label: Gate log
clue.title: Guard Harbans Singh's register
clue.text:
Sarah Menon — IN 10:12 PM, OUT 11:02 PM
Daniel Rathore — IN 11:15 PM

Sarah's statement: “I only dropped some papers at the gate around 10:15 and left. I never entered the house.”

twist_questions.question: Put the gate log beside the earlier clues. Which statement is true?
options: Sarah was on the property during the shouting and when the clock stopped
Sarah had already left by the time the coffee was served
Daniel reached home in time to hear the argument
The log agrees with what Sarah told the police

clue.label: Spare key
clue.title: Meera's statement
clue.text:
“The spare study key hangs on a hook behind the umbrella stand. Only Sir, Sarah madam and I know about it. Tonight it was lying in the hallway plant pot, with soil on it.

Cook Lakshmi was with me in the kitchen from 10:15 to 11:10.”

twist_questions.question: Who could have locked the study door with the spare key that night?
options: Meera, because she is the one who knows where it hangs
Daniel, when he came home at 11:15 PM
Sarah: she knew about the key, and Meera was with the cook
Anyone at all in the house, since the key was lying in the hallway plant pot

clue.label: Diary
clue.title: Vikram's diary, last page
clue.text: “S. has been moving company money into her own account. Confronting her tonight.”

twist_questions.question: What does the diary add to the 10:36 PM message?
options: It shows Vikram was planning to cut Daniel out of his will
It explains why he was ending the partnership, and why she could not let him reach his lawyer
It shows Meera had been taking money from the household account
It shows the lawyer was helping to move the company money

answer.explanation: It was murder staged as a burglary and a fall. Vikram had found that Sarah was moving company money and was ending the partnership. She came in at 10:12, had coffee with him (she takes sugar), they argued at about 10:45, and she struck him with the brass owl paperweight between his 10:36 message and 10:47, when the clock stopped. She wiped the paperweight, opened the window to fake a break-in, locked the door from outside with the spare key, dropped the key in the plant pot and left at 11:02. The dry sill, untouched flower bed, unmarked ladder and single head injury show the break-in and the fall were fake. Daniel's car was at the cinema until 11:01 and he reached the gate at 11:15. Meera was in the kitchen with the cook.
